name: Lovable
free_plan_limits: 5 build credits a day, up to 30 a month; 20 Cloud credits a month
usage_note: Pro: 100 credits a month plus 5 a day (per Lovable guides)
since_note: Public launch November 2024; company founded 2023 (Wikipedia, Anton Osika).
best_for: Describe an app, get a working one
notes: Price comes from Lovable's own guide pages; the pricing page itself did not load. Credits are used by every edit and expire after two months. Pro $21/mo billed yearly.

name: WordPress
free_plan_limits: WordPress.com subdomain, 1 GB storage, no plugins, no custom domain
notes: Priced WordPress.com hosting (the WordPress software itself is open source and free). Business is $40 monthly or $25 billed yearly. Free domain for year one only on yearly plans. Payments start at Premium.

name: Base44
free_plan_limits: 25 message credits and 100 integration credits a month, up to 5 apps
usage_note: Builder: 250 message credits and 10,000 integration credits a month
since_note: Came out of stealth March 2025; acquired by Wix June 2025 (Globes).
notes: Page shows yearly prices only (20% off); monthly-billing price not stated. Custom domain from Starter. GitHub sync listed from Builder up.

name: Replit
free_plan_limits: Starter: limited daily Agent use, one published app that expires after 30 days
usage_note: Deployments, storage and Agent use draw on monthly credits
best_for: Building and hosting apps in one place
notes: Core is $20 monthly or $18 billed yearly. Pro is $100 monthly. Page did not list custom domain or payment details.

name: Framer
free_plan_limits: Framer domain, 1 GB bandwidth, 1,000 pages, 500 AI credits to try
notes: Basic allows 30 pages and 2 CMS collections; Pro ($30) allows 150 pages. Yearly prices not listed on the page. Code export not mentioned.

name: Bubble
free_plan_limits: 500 AI credits and 50K workload units a month; no live site or custom domain
usage_note: Workload units measure server use; overages can be switched off
notes: Only yearly-billed prices shown (up to 20% off monthly). Priced per project. Code export not mentioned on the page.

name: Wix
free_plan_limits: Free site on a Wix domain (details not stated)
best_for: Small business sites with a store
notes: Prices shown are monthly equivalents on yearly billing; monthly-billing price not listed. Payments start at Core. Free domain for one year.

name: Bolt
free_plan_limits: 1M tokens a month, 300K a day, Bolt branding
usage_note: Pro: 10M tokens a month, unused roll over two months
notes: Custom domain is Pro only. Teams is $30 per member. Code export and payments not covered on the pricing page.

name: Softr
free_plan_limits: Up to 3 builders and 5 app users
usage_note: Basic: 1 builder, 5 team + 5 client users, 1 custom domain
best_for: Client portals on top of your data
notes: Prices from Softr's help docs (pricing page did not load): Basic $25 monthly or $19 yearly, Pro $119, Business $395. Older Softr pages show different numbers.

name: Emergent
since_note: Company founded 2024 per its CEO; platform launched about mid-2025 (Pulse 2.0, SiliconANGLE).
best_for: Web and mobile apps from a prompt
notes: Page says $20/month billed annually ($17 effective); monthly-billing price not stated. Hosting is listed as private project hosting on Standard. GitHub integration from Standard.

name: Webflow
notes: Plans were simplified in 2026: Basic $15/mo yearly (no CMS), Premium $25 yearly or $39 monthly. Free plan not stated in sources read. Pricing page itself did not load; figures from Webflow search snippets.

name: v0
free_plan_limits: 7 messages a day, deploy to Vercel, GitHub sync
usage_note: $30 of credits per user each month, plus $2 free daily; extra credits by model tokens
best_for: UI and front-end code from a prompt
notes: Deploys go to Vercel. Business is $100 per user. Custom domain, database and payments not covered on the page.

name: Hostinger Horizons
free_plan_limits: No free plan; 250 free AI credits to test
usage_note: Premium 250 one-time AI credits (Unlimited 500, Cloud Startup 1,000)
notes: Prices need a 48-month term: intro $1.99/mo, renewal $10.99/mo ($95.52 upfront). Monthly-billing price not stated. Credits are one-time, not monthly.
